pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and smooth pixel-level edge gradients. Individual regions exhibit high spatial area relative to the inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored pathways forming a grid-like network. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent intersections. The thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the visible flank.
